issues.description: Class name mismatch in the bitmap header: the template header declares class 'Image24' while the implementation and solution use 'Bitmap24'. This breaks C++ constructor semantics (constructors must match the class name) and will cause compilation/link errors or confusing diagnostics for students who try to use the provided Bitmap24 implementation but find the header declares a different identifier.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the header and implementation agree on the class identifier. Change the template header's class declaration from 'class Image24' to 'class Bitmap24' (or rename the implementation to Image24) so constructors and methods match and the project compiles as intended.
